native.primitives: Root DESIGN.md mobile-* colors, typography, rounded and components; native-* spacing. Existing unprefixed web tokens retain their scope.
native.units: React Native numeric logical units; DESIGN.md uses pixel strings for portable tooling. Browser translations render CSS pixels.
native.appearance: Customer system/light/dark preference selects role colors. Team follows system appearance. Exact pack photos keep white image surfaces; the original teal/mint raster mark retains its artwork in both modes.
native.type: Platform system fonts, fontFamily unset. Scaling enabled. English/Urdu text uses alignment and writingDirection; full layout mirroring is not claimed.
native.icons: Mapped iOS SF Symbols and Android Material Community icons, Ionicons fallback. Browser implementation is separate.
native.elevation: Flat bordered cards and tonal surfaces; no native shared shadow tokens.
native.storage: Native SecureStore for receipt keys, opt-in addresses and pending customer details; device-local basket, favourites, language, appearance, named lists, recent searches/viewed products and history. Browser private fields use sessionStorage.

review.retryFixes: Both material retry fixes resolved: only explicit order validation/stock-price rejection releases an attempt; uncertain responses preserve key and payload.
checks: Browser captures: home, categories, product, basket, Urdu

native.tokenAdvisories: Wrapper detector advisories #e5ebe7, #11231c, #f7f9f6 belong to the preview/native extension, not a replacement web palette.
native.tonalRamps: New native ramps are synthesized display metadata from source hex hue/chroma; runtime uses only the documented exact light/dark role values.

narrative.overview: The approved Everyday Market native refinement carries the temporary Daily Basket basket mark, teal role colors and real grocery photography into Expo/React Native. Native tokens retain mobile- names; unrelated web tokens retain their scope.
dos: Use the temporary Daily Basket wordmark with its original 3D teal basket raster.
Preserve real pack photography and catalog identities.
Use native role colors and system typography.
Keep guest checkout and server-authoritative totals explicit.
donts: Do not restore supplier branding as the customer identity.
Do not represent browser captures or JS exports as native-device QA or signed installations.
Do not introduce customer push, account syncing or live rider tracking claims.

operations.scope: operations-* frontmatter primitives document scoped --ops-* properties and reused literals. Existing unrelated web/native tokens and pre-existing sidecar drift are preserved.
operations.appearance: Web workspaces/apps intentionally light; Team follows system native light/dark roles.
operations.depth: Flat one-pixel borders and tonal groups; original raster brand artwork contains its own dimensional shading.
operations.focus: 3px solid #49a99a; outline-offset 3px on web workspace controls.
operations.layout: 238px sidebar; minmax(270px,.74fr) / minmax(0,1.5fr) workbench; maximum content width 1800px. Phone queue/detail replace each other.
operations.authority: New orders appear immediately to manager and picker. Picking/checking proceeds during bill review; manager approves/rejects Pending or Packing. Approval gates rider assignment/dispatch. Manager or owner receives exact rider cash and closes payment. Packers/riders cannot settle. Delivered and cash_confirmed are separate. Owner alone sees actual costs, expenses, sales/profit. Every staff action identifies its actor.
operations.finance: Costs frozen per order; missing cost leaves profit unknown; only recorded expenses deducted; periods use order placement date in Asia/Karachi. Owner Reset test earnings previews counts/sales and requires explicit confirmation; exclusions affect every financial period, preserving receipts/history/jobs and expenses. New orders count normally; Undo last reset restores only its batch. Owner API, snapshot guard, idempotency, private RLS/grants and audit enforce the action. No actual orders left excluded during verification.
operations.deliveryMap: Final 7 km straight-line radius from original store pin, 14 km across; road-routing choice superseded. App validation uses config.radius_km. Native/browser wrappers load public /delivery-map with server constants, circle fitBounds, main OSM tile URL, real document/referrer policy and restrictive CSP. Native user-agent identifies the app, limits navigation to the map route and sends initial pin on load without URL coordinates. Browser 390px tiles verified; no native phone QA.
operations.team: One Android Team app; packer/rider views by individual owner-created account. Foreground refresh 10 seconds and resume; native background push not configured, keep-open copy explicit.

security.change: Owner authority plus current password; at least 12 new characters; atomic auth-version update invalidates older sessions and replacement session keeps current browser signed in.
security.recovery: Server-fixed email; server-only Resend sending key; 256-bit secret URL-fragment token, SHA-256 hash stored, expiry 15 minutes, single-use, global/IP limits; atomic reset consumes token and invalidates previous owner sessions.
security.status: User explicitly deferred Resend/email setup until later. No sending key saved and no email sent. Email recovery requests stay disabled until the user resumes setup and verifies a live send; phone recovery disabled.
security.evidence: Hosted migration 20261021114407 applied and local tests passed per parent; real owner password unchanged in tests. owner-security-desktop/mobile and owner-recovery-desktop browser captures exist; recovery phone capture pending.
security.staffPasswordControl: Owner Team access has dedicated Change password per manager/packer/rider row, new-password confirmation and success notice. Existing owner-only team API hashes password, increments auth_version and revokes older sessions, preserving role/access. Owner own password still requires current password in Account security.
security.staffPasswordVerification: Parent live HTTP check created temporary packer, reset via owner API, proved old-password rejection, old bearer-session revocation, new-password acceptance, role preservation and disable revocation; temporary staff removed. No customer orders or real owner password changed.
security.staffPreview: Three clearly fictional practice manager/packer/rider fixtures. Password controls can be reviewed, but inputs/save disabled and save handler exits in preview.

narrative.overview:
Daily Basket is a temporary customer identity: an original dimensional 3D teal basket mark beside a readable wordmark. The user clarified that Askari supplies inventory and revoked its customer-facing name/logo. The mark was generated without a supplier image or logo reference. No supplier logo ships; future work must follow the customer identity shown in `components/StoreLogo.tsx` and `mobile/src/ui.tsx`. The final name is pending.

The established website uses white shelves, pale aqua fields, teal controls and Poppins typography. The approved Everyday Market native refinement carries the same grocery clarity through compact system typography, photographic browsing and exact pack identity. Native tokens use `mobile-` names and `native-` spacing; unrelated incumbent web tokens retain their scope. The preview frame belongs only to the labelled browser wrapper. The approved operations extension uses deliberately light work surfaces, deep teal navigation and role-focused actions. Its tokens use operations- names and do not replace the web or native scopes.
keyCharacteristics: Real pack photographs and visible pack sizes.
Teal actions, quiet bordered surfaces and explicit stock states.
A compact basket wordmark without supplier branding.
Native system typography and readable light/dark role colors.
Clear quantity, delivery-progress and server-confirmed order feedback.

rules.name: The Real Shelf Rule
rules.body: Display imported selling prices and actual stock. No invented markup, discount, rating or availability may be added to customer screens.

rules.name: The Separate State Rule
rules.body: Delivery and returned cash must have separate labels and actions; color alone cannot communicate either state.

rules.name: The Familiar Name Rule
rules.body: Keep real package names, brands and variants in ordinary case; package photography carries their own lettering.

rules.name: The Shelf Border Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal surfaces to separate grocery information; keep product photography clear of decorative depth.

dos: **Do** use Daily Basket as a temporary customer wordmark with the original 3D teal basket artwork until the final name is confirmed.
**Do** preserve exact pack photography, real brand/variant labels, imported prices and explicit stock states.
**Do** scope native light/dark roles to the app and its identified preview/privacy wrappers.
**Do** keep guest checkout, current-stock list/reorder checks and server-confirmed totals clear.
**Do** retain supplier provenance, real contacts, 7 km straight-line PGECHS dispatch coverage from the original store pin, COD rules, compatible storage namespaces and authenticated staff tools.
donts: **Don't** restore Askari's name or supplier-logo artwork as the customer-facing identity.
**Don't** import reference-store names, logos, promotions or unrelated departments.
**Don't** invent selling prices, discounts, rewards, live tracking or payment confirmation.
**Don't** present browser captures or JavaScript exports as native-device QA, signed installations or app-store publication.
**Don't** treat the temporary name as final before store publication; preserve the already authorized signing identifiers and compatibility namespaces.
